policies.description: Only users whose confirmed role is Administrator, Manager, or Agent may create a Change record (full CRUD permission on the change table).
references: Administrator (admin) | System Configuration & Integrity | Full CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) access across all tables.
Manager (manager) | Supervision, Escalation, Approvals | Full CRUD on operational tables (incident, problem, change, knowledge); READ access to all the tables.
Agent (agent) | Frontline Incident/Request fulfillment | Full CRUD on Incidents, Service Requests, Tasks, Work Notes, CMDB, Change, Problem, and Knowledge.

policies.policy_name: Mandatory Fields Validation for Change Creation
policies.description: All mandatory fields for the change request (short_description, status, impact, risk, priority) must be present and non‑null before calling create_change.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: The status field supplied to create_change must be one of the allowed change status enumeration values.
The impact field supplied to create_change must be one of the allowed impact values (high, medium, low).
The priority field supplied to create_change must be one of the allowed priority values (critical, high, moderate, low, planning).
If an assigned_to user ID is provided, the referenced user must have users.active = true.
references: User Status: Ensure any user being assigned to (assigned_to) or updated is users.active = true.
